name: XCrawl
tagline: Turn any web page into LLM-ready JSON or Markdown.
description: XCrawl is a web data API for AI builders. Scrape a URL into Markdown, JSON, HTML or a screenshot; crawl a whole site with depth and scope rules; map every URL on a domain; or pull structured results from search engines. Rendering, proxy rotation and retries run on XCrawl's side. Python and Node.js SDKs, a CLI, an MCP server and an n8n node are available; new accounts start with 1,000 free credits.
